message: Could Rohin’s reported raw-child example—carrying an unfinished step forward and checking what happened—help you do your own work instead of asking your reader to choose? What could further thought settle about 1345 × 100, or would a small attempt provide better evidence? What thinking or doing step will you choose and perform yourself next? What observation would change that choice? What finding, uncertainty, and unfinished next step will you carry forward, and what is the finding’s source?
